evidence.claim: Chiorino dal 1906 a Biella produce e distribuisce soluzioni di nastri leggeri per settori come packaging alimentare, intralogistica, aeroporti e stampa.
evidence.quote: Chiorino was founded in 1906 in Biella by Lorenzo Chiorino and is today a leading international company in the manufacturing and distribution of lightweight belting solutions. || An extensive network of fabrication and distribution centers for a close customer proximity and a state of the art service in 5 continents. || Food Packaging Paper and Printing Intralogistics Airports Textile Raw Materials Cutting and Punching Recycling Sports Automotive and Tyre
